exposure: Women with low (≤30%) level of Factor XI compared to those with higher levels
cohort: 74 pregnant women with Factor XI deficiency
finding: Women with low levels of Factor XI were significantly more likely to receive fresh frozen plasma and less likely to receive neuroaxial anesthesia, but there were no differences in other obstetric or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with low levels of Factor XI were significantly more likely to receive fresh frozen plasma and less likely to receive neuraxial anesthesia, but there was no difference in mode of delivery.
